description: A sprite sheet of SIX separate props arranged in a grid of 2 columns and 3 rows (two props side by side in each row), each centered in its own wide cell, in this exact order: top row left: a small low rustic wooden hut with a sloped plank roof, a plank door and one tiny window, wide and low, filling most of its cell; top row right: a small empty wooden rowboat seen from the side with two oars resting inside, wide and low, filling most of its cell width; middle row left: a soot-blackened antique brass Aether measuring machine driven into the ground on an iron spike, with a round gauge dial and needle on top and exposed brass gears on its side; middle row right: an old wooden box beehive with a sloped lid standing on a short wooden stand; bottom row left: a clump of tall green river reeds with a few brown cattails; bottom row right: a short thick weathered wooden mooring post with a rope coiled around it, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, muted natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no water, no shadow puddles, no text, no numbers, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their 3 by 3 layout.
